topic: What happens if you stare at screens all day?
title: What staring at screens does
hook: What happens if you stare at screens all day?

beats.label: 1 HOUR
beats.line: After an hour of screens, you blink far less than normal.

beats.label: 4 HOURS
beats.line: By four hours, your eyes feel dry, and your vision can blur.

beats.label: 6 HOURS
beats.line: After six hours, eye strain can bring on a headache.

beats.label: 8 HOURS
beats.line: By eight hours, your neck and shoulders start to ache.

beats.label: 12 HOURS
beats.line: By evening, screen light can delay your sleep.

end.line: So, when did you last look away from a screen?

description: Hour by hour: what a full day of screens does to your eyes and sleep.

facts.claim: Blink rate drops significantly during screen use, which can dry out the eyes.
Digital eye strain (computer vision syndrome) can cause dry eyes, blurred vision, and headaches.
Eye doctors recommend the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
Evening exposure to screen light can suppress melatonin and delay sleep onset.
